items.title: US Cybersecurity Job Postings Fall 26% as AI Security Engineer Demand Soars
items.summary:
Kevin Townsend reports: Data for CyberSN’s jobs report is aggregated from JobSpikr (with duplicates removed). The various job titles are then analyzed and assigned to CyberSN’s taxonomy of 45 cybersecurity functional roles in ten categories. The result is an assessment of the job market by skills required rather than by the recruiting companies’ role titles....

items.summary:

items.title: KR: NHIS Employee Sold Data, Victims Uninformed for Three Months
items.summary:
In today’s reminder of the insider threat, Kim Ji-won reports: A National Health Insurance Service (NHIS) employee was dismissed for illegally selling personal information of health insurance subscribers to external parties, but victims have yet to be notified of the data breach. items.summary:
Debra Ahmed reports: An unprotected database linked to India-based AI software development and IT services company Vibetech exposed 13.7 million records containing credentials and other sensitive information from previous data breaches. items.summary:
